misprints.note: Printed without an accent (hyphenated πτε-ρωμα); kept as printed.
The 'anförare för f. man' sense is πεντηκοστήρ (cf. πεντηκοντήρ); the print has -ής for both forms. Kept as printed.
An ordinal adjective normally has three terminations; the print gives 2. Kept as printed.

uncertain.note: The τ before -άκις is short and looks like ι (broken type or a misprint πεντηκονιάκις). I transcribed it as τ.
